blocks.content: A final complication is sexual selection, non-random mating based on traits involved in mate choice (Chapter 29). In many species, mate choice is at least partly based on trait values, either through male-male competition for access to females or through female choice of specific males. Sexual selection for particular traits can result in very interesting evolutionary dynamics, especially when sexually preferred trait values conflict with natural selection (viability and/or fertility selection).
